title: Reduced-manifold error amplification diagnostic
purpose: Determine whether the state-shape drift identified by C1 is primarily sustained accumulation of local bias or amplification of existing reduced-state deviations under the unchanged C0 flow map, before any stabilizer, state enrichment or closure change is introduced.

execution_condition.rule: Do not execute C2 if C1R does not recover the blocked 2.5-cm WT_CYCLE temporal qualification with classification stability.

predecessor_authority.C1_blocker: 2.5 cm WT_CYCLE at dt=0.0001 day only; Reference projections finite and decomposition identities valid
observed_C1_pattern_before_C1R: state_shape is STATE_DRIFT_DOMINANT in all seven fully dual-route-qualified width/history cases
qi and qH are local-closure-dominant for the 2.5-cm dynamic cases already qualified, but state-drift-dominant for the 5-cm dynamic cases
no global closure replacement is authorized by C1

unchanged_model.model: exact BC2-C0 enriched prescribed-H reduced dynamics
unchanged_model.H_input: same qualified externally prescribed BC2-A2 Reference H(t)

numerical_route.authority: use C1R-recovered route after successful C1R; chosen before C1R outcome because it is the already-qualified C1 cross route

diagnostic_A_actual_drift_gain.description: Follow the actual C0 free trajectory and, at each observation interval, compare its start-of-interval deviation from the exact Reference-projected reduced state with the one-interval state-induced component free_end - teacher_end under identical H(t).
diagnostic_A_actual_drift_gain.coordinates: physical reduced storage components only; cumulative diagnostic states excluded
diagnostic_A_actual_drift_gain.state_shape_norm: RMS over normalized compartment water-content deviations, not raw storage, so unequal compartment thickness does not dominate the norm
metrics: g_k = ||free_end-teacher_end||_shape / ||free_start-reference_start||_shape when denominator exceeds the numerical floor
median, 95th percentile and maximum g_k per width/history
fraction of eligible intervals with g_k > 1
cumulative product of log(g_k) reported only over eligible intervals as a diagnostic, not as a fitted Lyapunov exponent
angle/cosine between previous shape-error vector and propagated state-induced vector
local teacher-reference shape-error norm alongside g_k
interpretation: g_k > 1 means the unchanged one-interval reduced map amplifies the existing actual shape deviation over that interval.
g_k < 1 means the existing deviation contracts, even if repeated local closure bias may still accumulate.
This is a trajectory-direction diagnostic and is not a global linear-stability theorem.

diagnostic_B_blind_tangent_panel.execution_trigger: Execute only after Diagnostic A result is frozen; the perturbation panel below is nevertheless frozen now and may not be tuned from Diagnostic A.

state_selection.rule: For each width/history select fixed observation fractions 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 of the history plus the interval immediately preceding each prescribed H-direction switch; duplicates removed.

diagnostic_B_blind_tangent_panel.perturbation_coordinates: mass-neutral pairwise transfers in normalized mean-water-content coordinates between adjacent reduced compartments; total physical water storage held fixed to roundoff
diagnostic_B_blind_tangent_panel.admissibility: Skip a perturbation direction only when either signed perturbation leaves the strict constitutive domain; report the skipped direction, do not shrink epsilon post hoc.
outputs: one-interval directional amplification factors for each admissible shape mode
largest measured shape-mode gain at each frozen state
relation of high-gain states to H direction and terminal width
diagnostic_B_blind_tangent_panel.interpretation: Supports local tangent-instability evidence only where the two frozen perturbation amplitudes give consistent directional gains.
diagnostic_B_blind_tangent_panel.mass_neutral_projection: At the output boundary, remove the uniform total-storage component before computing the primary shape-mode amplification. Report differential total-storage response separately.
diagnostic_B_blind_tangent_panel.direction_definition: For adjacent compartments i,j, +epsilon is applied to theta_i and theta_j changes by -epsilon*L_i/L_j so the signed perturbation has zero total water storage; the negative branch uses the exact opposite perturbation.

decision_logic.BIAS_ACCUMULATION_DOMINANT: Actual-drift gains are predominantly contractive/non-amplifying while local teacher-reference shape bias persists; investigate local closure bias source rather than a stabilizer.
decision_logic.MANIFOLD_AMPLIFICATION_SUPPORTED: Actual-drift gain repeatedly exceeds one and blind mass-neutral tangent perturbations show consistent gain >1 in corresponding regimes; investigate invariant/manifold stability before changing closure formulas.
decision_logic.MIXED_STATE_DYNAMICS: Amplification is regime/width dependent or tangent and actual-drift diagnostics disagree; retain per-channel/per-regime classification and do not introduce a global stabilizer.
decision_logic.NUMERICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: frozen perturbation or integration routes do not support a finite, converged diagnosis.

pre_execution_numerical_clarification.role: Numerical zero/noise guard only; intervals below this start-error norm are INELIGIBLE_FOR_GAIN rather than assigned zero or infinite gain.

pre_execution_shape_metric_clarification.theta_error_vector: For each physical reduced control volume convert storage error to mean-water-content error by dividing by its instantaneous thickness.
pre_execution_shape_metric_clarification.total_storage_component: delta_theta_uniform = sum(delta_W_i) / sum(L_i). Report total storage error separately.
pre_execution_shape_metric_clarification.mass_neutral_shape_vector: e_shape_i = delta_theta_i - delta_theta_uniform. This has sum(L_i*e_shape_i)=0 to roundoff.
pre_execution_shape_metric_clarification.primary_shape_norm: unweighted RMS over e_shape_i so each reduced control volume contributes one shape coordinate independent of thickness.
pre_execution_shape_metric_clarification.secondary_raw_theta_norm: unweighted RMS over uncentered delta_theta_i, reported diagnostically.
pre_execution_shape_metric_clarification.floor_role: pure numerical division guard; not a hydrological acceptance threshold
pre_execution_shape_metric_clarification.below_floor_semantics: report BELOW_GAIN_DENOMINATOR_FLOOR and do not assign g_k

diagnostic_A.shape_coordinate: mean water-content error per physical reduced compartment: 9 fixed 10-cm layers, moving bulk Wb/B, terminal Wt/d
diagnostic_A.shape_norm: RMS over the 11 mean-water-content error components
diagnostic_A.gain: g_k = RMS(free_end-teacher_end shape error) / RMS(free_start-reference_start shape error)
diagnostic_A.cosine: dot(previous shape-error, propagated state-induced shape-error)/(L2 norms) where both norms exceed the same numerical floor
diagnostic_A.predominantly_amplifying: fraction of eligible intervals with g_k > 1.0 is greater than 0.5
diagnostic_A.note: The 1e-12 floor is only a division-by-near-zero eligibility floor, not a hydrological acceptance threshold.

diagnostic_B.fraction_start_indices: for history length N use start-state indices 0, floor(N/4), floor(N/2), floor(3N/4)
diagnostic_B.switch_start_indices: add the start-state index immediately preceding every sign change of successive prescribed H increments; duplicates removed
diagnostic_B.mass_neutral_adjacent_transfer: for adjacent compartments i,j with thicknesses Li,Lj, apply delta_theta_i=+epsilon and delta_theta_j=-epsilon*Li/Lj; the opposite signed perturbation is used for the central difference
diagnostic_B.gain: RMS of central-difference output shape perturbation divided by RMS of the central-difference input shape perturbation
diagnostic_B.amplitude_support: A mode is locally amplification-supporting only when both frozen amplitudes produce gain > 1.0. Amplitude gain ratios are reported without a fitted consistency tolerance.
diagnostic_B.state_support: A frozen state supports local tangent amplification when at least one adjacent transfer mode is amplification-supporting at both amplitudes.

final_classification_implementation.MANIFOLD_AMPLIFICATION_SUPPORTED: At least one width/history is predominantly amplifying in Diagnostic A and at least one frozen Diagnostic-B state in that same width/history supports local tangent amplification.
final_classification_implementation.BIAS_ACCUMULATION_DOMINANT: No width/history is predominantly amplifying in Diagnostic A and no frozen Diagnostic-B state supports local tangent amplification.
final_classification_implementation.MIXED_STATE_DYNAMICS: All other finite hard-gated combinations, including regime-dependent amplification or disagreement between A and B.
final_classification_implementation.NUMERICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: Any inherited hard gate, constitutive-domain requirement, or required frozen perturbation route fails.

pre_execution_algorithm_clarification.scientific_effect: Clarifies deterministic implementation of already preregistered diagnostics before C1R result exposure; no model, state, closure, forcing, width, amplitude or acceptance threshold is changed.
